opening.argument: The material presents an educational comparison of Bitcoin's stated supply with the amount of fiat currency discussed, using coin imagery and shipping containers to make the scale understandable. The narration explains that all 21 million Bitcoin, if represented by quarter-sized coins, would fit in one shipping container, while the dollars described as printed daily would require 72 containers: "If a Bitcoin was the size of a quarter all 21 million and that would fit inside a single shipping container But to fit the dollars that fed prints on average every day you'd need 72 shipping containers". The description expressly frames the content as informational and states, "Nothing discussed in this video is intended to be investment advice." The subscription request is ordinary channel engagement, while the explanatory framing and disclaimer distinguish the discussion from a solicitation.
